name: B10-0291/2025 (Renew) – Dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Mali's military rulers for dissolving all political parties in May 2025 and for cracking down on opposition, civil society and journalists. It asks the authorities to cancel that decree, restore the legal status of parties, release people held for political reasons, and set out a clear timetable for free elections. It also calls on the European Union and its member states to rethink how they deal with Mali and to consider targeted sanctions if the repression continues.

- Mali's rulers must cancel the party ban and restore political parties' legal status.
- People jailed for political reasons should be freed; the EU may consider sanctions.
- The EU is urged to rethink its engagement with Mali and support democracy groups.
